title: Transfer - IQC Supplier Anomaly Normalization
goal: Normalize incoming quality inspection anomaly remarks for supplier lots into a material-defect codebook, using item category, inspection stage, and lot context to separate true codebook matches from ambiguous notes.
skillBenefitRationale: This is a distinct transfer to supplier quality inspection, but success still depends on the same shipped skill: converting inconsistent human-written defect descriptions into standard codebook labels with context-aware matching and UNKNOWN escalation.
